reason: First full entities:enrich batch shipped with an image-host guard that rejected every Commons thumbnail. The batch had already written per-entity cache markers, so the buggy pass had to be stopped and markers cleared. Recording the verify-on-sample rule and the host/markers gotchas for WikidataDetailFinder.
Bulk Wikidata run in staging produced wrong images (scooter given kei-car photo), needed stop, marker clear, and cleanup, and silently overwrote manual spec rows. Captured guard and rollback rules.

Logo batch on staging exposed that P18 gave HQ photos for brands, dry-run caught it, and the backup in container /tmp would be lost on recreate. Also two post-batch misfits (Vespa, DFSK) only found by visual check.
Folded into entity-catalog-maintenance; detail carried in references/wikidata-enrichment.md.
